cases.assertion: The disposition inventory exactly covers every supported Authoring 1.7 schema field after declared semantic-child boundaries; new or missing fields fail closed.
Every field key is unique within its semantic unit and has exactly one member of the closed five-class vocabulary.
entity/gap#/context maps to metadata.semantic_extensions with its complete exact string value.
Removing or changing the gap context semantic-extension value is semantic loss even when metadata.source_semantics retains the original source bytes/value.
Moving a field to another runtime source JSON Pointer, root traversal position, candidate filename, or embedded location does not change the stable field key or semantic identity.
Structured extension values preserve JSON type, object members, array order where declared, and nested values without coercion.
title to name, status to lifecycle_stage, evidence kind to evidence_kind, and related_entities to related_entity_ids are exact lossless canonical placements.
Topology compatibility equality uses type, owner scope when material, resolved endpoint UUIDs, authored semantic properties, and multiplicity; generated IDs and pointers are excluded.
Normative-proposition lifecycle is absent only under the named lifecycle-free rule; an implementation omission of any other field is not declared absence.

schema_version and fixed adr_type discriminators are derivable from the exact selected authoring schema and are deterministic ceremony; authored status, aliases, dates, UUIDs, custom qualification, and relationship meaning are never ceremony.
Embedded semantic children retain their own UUID and field ledger exactly once; parent membership carries child identity/order only and never duplicates the child payload.
Standalone semantic fragments remain native roots and mixed root sets are aggregated without synthetic ADR wrapping.
Reordering identity-keyed child collections leaves semantic identity and equality unchanged; multiplicity and duplicate-identity rejection remain governed.
Reordering entity/data_flow#/path changes its ordered semantic value and therefore equality.
Unclassified compatibility endpoint, custom qualification, semantic extension, or unresolved record fails closed rather than yielding equivalent success.
CEC-qualified custom entity/relationship meaning includes exact qualification, UUID identity, custom property values, endpoint identities, and relationship multiplicity.
A detached scope and root locator derive only from the exact basis digest, source_ref UTF-8 digest, and fixed domain constants and cannot be interpreted as a repository path or admission.
AI 1.1 remains independently valid under its original SCF and frozen conformance resource; AI 1.2 does not rewrite historical authority.
